issues.description: The solution's addGuestStudents method returns a boolean (public boolean addGuestStudents(int)) while the problem statement UML and the task description specify addGuestStudents(int) : void. This return-type mismatch between the specification/template and the solution is a structural inconsistency that can confuse students about the intended signature and expected behavior of the method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the addGuestStudents method signature consistent across artifacts. Either change the solution implementation to match the UML and template by using 'public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)' and update its body to simply add the new guests (handling negative input as desired), or update the problem statement and template UML to declare addGuestStudents(int): boolean and document the meaning of the boolean return value. Prefer aligning the solution to the UML (void) to preserve the original specification.
